content.comment_body: Hello everyone, in the up/down counter window, there's an option called 'reference.' Can anyone explain what it means, perhaps with an example? Thanks.

You can obtain a value from another block using the 'reference' option. This works only when a block is available that can provide its value. For example, if you have an analog block, the value from this block can be utilized in other blocks—for instance, to set the time of a delay or serve as a value for a counter. Feel free to experiment with this at home!

analysis.insight_summary: Users find the 'reference' option in the up/down counter window unclear and are looking for practical information on its function. Responses help clarify that it enables using values from one block in another, though no detailed examples or documentation are provided.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a straightforward explanation or example showing how and when to use the 'reference' feature in the up/down counter window.
